finding.description: Fixed distractor recipes reveal the correct pair through repeated operation components. When the first operation has a unique mode occurring twice and the second operation also has a unique mode, selecting their combined pair succeeds on 102/102 sampled occurrences across five profiles. Delivered batch question dae1d6e6-8d41-5592-b4ba-d9ab62dba0c5, seed 2967220665, exhibits this defect.

finding.reproduction: From evidence_root run /home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/.venv/bin/python shortcut_regression.py; the strict regression fails. Minimal parameters: seed=842, bank_profile="q-91189", A=[[4,2,-6],[1,3,4],[5,-1,2]], row=0, pivot=1, ks=[-2,0,3]. The coefficient bank is [(-1,3),(2,3),(-2,3),(-2,-3),(-3,2)]. Component frequencies identify the correct pair (-2,3) without reading either matrix. This succeeds under all 120 option permutations.
finding.requested_change: Revise runtime distractor construction across affected profiles so component-frequency patterns do not reliably identify correctness. Preserve source replay and legitimate matrix variation; shuffling options or suppressing affected profiles does not repair the rule. Retain the shortcut regression and regenerate the affected batch after repair.

reason.summary: An answer-option frequency shortcut bypasses matrix reasoning and affects one of the five delivered batch questions. Other checks passed. The package remained unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Infer two column-addition multipliers that transform a 3×3 matrix into a given matrix with two zeros in one row.
reasoning_steps: Identify the specified unchanged pivot column and cleared row.
Calculate each multiplier from the target-row entries.
invariants: Two nontrivial integer column additions sharing a nonzero pivot.
3×3 integer matrices and one five-choice radio field.
Worked solutions show both matrix transformations.
permitted_variations: Pivot column, cleared row, multiplier signs and magnitudes.
Off-target entries with corresponding matrix updates.

source_replay.details: Replayed all ten complete practice banks and canonical parameters. Verified the documented source-summary correction and equivalent bank alias.

math.details: Independently checked 246 records using exact integer operations, including every choice and worked matrix stage.

variety.details: Exercised all nine row/pivot assignments, four multiplier-sign combinations and nine bank profiles. The separate decision-variation check fails.

scope.details: Preserves the easy two-operation matrix task and radio response contract.

grading.details: Native grading accepted 246 correct choices and rejected 984 wrong choices, including controlled counterfactual cases.

rendering.details: Fourteen actual-UI renders passed; seven representative screenshots were visually inspected.

packaging.details: Exact dependency versions, relocation, deterministic replay and invalid-input rejection passed. Package files remained unchanged.

decision_variation.details: An option-only frequency strategy correctly answers 102/102 recognizably applicable sampled questions and one of five batch questions. The shortcut survives delivery and option permutation. Captured inventory contains only original source questions, with no generated historical records.
